concept.title: Why Use a VPN
concept.shortdesc: How do encrypted connections protect you when accessing campus resources from remote or public networks.

conbody.p: When you work remotely from home, travel, or use public Wi-Fi networks, your internet traffic can be exposed to interception on untrusted networks. Using Cisco Secure Client establishes an encrypted connection between your device and the NC State University network.
Connecting to the NC State VPN provides two primary protections for remote users:

ul.li: Encrypted traffic on public Wi-Fi: Secures your connection to the university network when you are working on public or unsecured wireless networks.
Access to campus-restricted resources: Enables you to safely reach university services, sensitive data, and internal resources that are restricted to on-campus network connections.

conbody.note: If you borrow a Mac or Windows laptop from the Hill, Hunt, Design, Natural Resources, or Veterinary Medicine Libraries, Cisco Secure Client is already installed and ready to use.
